factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'The Group’s net loss, excluding goodwill impairment, amounted to EUR -1.9 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased to EUR 27.5 million, primarily because of the impairment; excluding it, operating expenses were EUR 21.8 million, 1% below 2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial information: 'Operating expenses reached EUR 27.5m and 25% higher than in 2023. However, amount of operating expenses for 2024 includes 5.7m EUR losses of goodwill impairment. factual_claims.claim: Net finance expenses also increased to EUR 1.2 million from EUR 0.5 million, reflecting higher foreign-exchange and realised derivative losses.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Management attributed the overall deterioration to increased competition and oversupply of travel in the Baltic States, which led to intense price competition, particularly for Turkey and the Greek islands.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'The overall result for the year was driven by the previously announced reasons, i.e. the increased competitive environment and the oversupply of travel in the Baltic States, which triggered intense price competition. This was particularly felt in Turkey and the Greek islands.'

factual_claims.claim: Flight-package revenue, the Group’s main product, fell to EUR 170.7 million from EUR 182.8 million, while other sales increased to EUR 25.4 million from EUR 20.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue from contracts with customers table shows Flight package tours: 170,697 (2024) vs 182,833 (2023). Other sales: 25,360 (2024) vs 20,899 (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Destination diversification included strong growth in Spain and long-haul travel, with long-haul passengers increasing 8% and the fourth-quarter load factor improving to 98.9% from 96.7%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'We see significant growth in the number of trips to Spain... For long-haul trips, Novaturas also managed to achieve an extremely high load factor of 98.9%.' Load factor comparison: 98.9% (Q4 2024) vs 96.7% (2023).

factual_claims.claim: Performance improved significantly late in the year: adjusted EBITDA was negative EUR 1.6 million in January–June but positive EUR 2.3 million in September–December.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'Following weaker performance in the first half of the year (January – June 2024 adjusted EBITDA – -1.6 million EUR), the Group’s operating results showed material improvement starting from September 2024 (September – December 2024 adjusted EBITDA 2.3 million EUR).'

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s optimization of its travel program, reduced last-minute sales and improved capacity utilization supported profitable fourth-quarter operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'The results of the last quarter of the year show that our optimization of the travel program has been effective... The share of last-minute trips in sales... has also decreased significantly... This has contributed to a higher load factor... in the fourth quarter.'

factual_claims.claim: Financial pressure increased, with year-end cash falling to EUR 0.4 million from EUR 3.3 million, equity declining to EUR 8.0 million from EUR 15.7 million, and the debt-to-equity ratio rising to 121.1% from 58.0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statements of financial position show Cash and cash equivalents: 394 (Group 2024) vs 3,347 (2023). Total equity: 8,020 (2024) vs 15,653 (2023). Debt/equity ratio: 121.1% (2024) vs 58.0% (2023) in Alternative Performance Measures table.

factual_claims.claim: The Group breached financing covenants but received waivers.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: 'As at 31 December 2024, the Group did not comply with all financial and non-financial covenants... The waivers were received from “Pagalbos verslui fondas” for ordinary bonds as of 31 December 2024 and from Luminor Bank AS long-term for credit line as of 18 March 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Subsequent financing and the acquisition of a 23.2% stake by investor Neset Kockar were identified as support for the going-concern assessment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events after the reporting period: 'In the end of April, 2025 we also announced about the signing of an agreement under which the Group is implementing the first stage of a transaction with the strategic investor: 23.2% of the Group’s shares is being acquired by Mr Kockar.'
